title: Abyssals v0.90.43 — Fort Lift, Auto-Hatching and Codex Filters
notes: Reuses the original Grand Exchange pixel-art lift east of the Sunken Fort salvage chests on all five floors, with accessible stations, known-floor-only travel and safe arrivals. Eggs hatch automatically once ready, together when simultaneous, with individual reveals and safe party/reserve placement. Nursery pairing supports up to ten eggs in one transaction, bounded by pouch capacity, available funds and consumable supplies, with independent shiny and inheritance rolls. Grand Exchange codices filter by Status/Physical/Special and move type, including combinations and maintained selections after purchase. Preserves old save data, permanent death, package identity, signing and offline PWA.
